data.text:
/**
 * ## Intersection of `null` type
 *
 * Demonstrates composition of references, inline types and inappropriate types for intersection.
 *
 * @privateRemarks
 *
 * ###### allOf.1
 * It has to be combined with `properties`-section from previous part to get `{  id: string; }`.
 *
 * ###### Intersection of `null` type
 * This is inappropriate type for this intersection. But there is ready solution for this case. It leaves up to you at designing time.
 */
export type ReferredTypesCompositionAndInline = {
  id: string;
} & null &
  InlineObjectCompositionProperties &
  InlineObjectCompositionPropertiesWithNot &
  InlineObjectCompositionPatterns &
  InlineObjectCompositionPropertiesAndPatterns &
  InlineMixedComposition;

data.text:
/**
 * ## comprehensive-schema
 *
 * Complex schema with all possible types
 *
 * @privateRemarks
 *
 * todo: add comments for all entries
 *
 * ###### InlineObjectCompositionProperties
 * Use case: inline composition of objects with properties
 *
 * ###### InlineObjectCompositionPropertiesWithNot
 * Use case: inline composition of object with a NOT-construction
 *
 * ###### ExclusionFromUnionInline
 * `allOf` with combination of a reference to `SimpleUnionWithRefs` and `not` to `ArrayMinScalar` has to be: `Exclude<SimpleUnionWithRefs, ArrayMinScalar>`
 */
export type ComprehensiveSchema =
  | {
      delegatedFrom?: ComprehensiveSchema;
      delegatedTo?: ComprehensiveSchema;
    }
  | InlineObjectCompositionProperties
  | InlineObjectCompositionPropertiesWithNot
  | InlineObjectCompositionPatterns
  | InlineObjectCompositionPropertiesAndPatterns
  | InlineMixedComposition
  | ReferredTypesComposition
  | ReferredTypesCompositionAndInline
  | InlineArrayMinItemsPrefixItemsComposition
  | InlineArrayMinMaxItemsPrefixItemsComposition
  | InlineArrayNestedComposition
  | InlineObjectNestedComposition
  | ExclusionFromUnion
  | Exclude<SimpleUnionWithRefs, ArrayMinScalar>
  | SimpleUnionWithRefs
  | NonWorkingExclusionFromUnionByAnyOf
  | ObjectIfThenElseEnumWithMixin
  | SimpleOneOfUnionWithRefsToArray
  | SimpleOneOfUnionWithRefsToObjects
  | SimpleOneOfUnionWithObjects
  | SimpleOneOfUnionWithMixedTypes
  | FirstLevel
  | PatternString
  | SimplestStringPatternCase
  | SimpleDynamicRef;
